generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of pet grooming salon (宠物美容店). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Show a boutique pet grooming salon in one coherent wide portrait view. One small dog stands safely on the grooming table beneath the grooming arm while a groomer brushes its back, leaving the dog and equipment unobstructed. A raised pet bath occupies the rear-right area with one shampoo pump on its rim. On a foreground trolley, separate the slicker brush, clippers and nail grinder; fold the absorbent towel below and place the bow-tie collar alone beside it. Bright diffuse salon lighting, clean tile and stainless steel, anatomically correct animal and hands, no extra pets.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: pet groomer, grooming table, grooming arm, slicker brush, pet clippers, pet nail grinder, pump bottle of pet shampoo, raised pet bath, absorbent pet towel, bow-tie pet collar.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
